_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: bias 2, SD of differences 5

agreement.claim: both engines report the same bias, limits, intervals, proportional-bias slope and correlation
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 1e-10. harness/agreement_examples.test.py recomputes the lower limit from the differences and shows the correlation exceeds 0.9 in every seed while the bias interval excludes 0 in over 90%.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The bias tolerance separates the bias (2) from zero. Measured by harness/agreement_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
